test_objective: Check temporal pagination is applied when querying the temporal evolution of entities
keywords: Get Least Recent Timestamp From Vehicles
Get Most Recent Timestamp From Vehicles

test_cases.name: 021_15_01 retrieve the entity with lastN and timerel before
test_cases.doc: Check temporal pagination behavior on multiple entity endpoint
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/temporal/entities'
        method set to 'GET'
        Query Temporal Representation of Entities and
    Query Parameter: entity_types set to '${entity_types_to_be_retrieved}' and
    Query Parameter: options set to 'lastN=${20}' and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: timerel set to '${timerel}' and
    Query Parameter: timeAt set to '${timeAt}' and
    Query Parameter: endTimeAt set to '${endTimeAt}' and
    Query Parameter: lastN set to '${lastN}'
}
